test.title: Section 2 · fire evacuation and staff suggestions

texts.label: A
texts.title: Fire evacuation: what staff and wardens do

paragraphs.text: Fire evacuation: what staff and wardens do. Every floor of the building has at least two fire wardens, whose names and photographs are displayed beside the lifts. Wardens are volunteers who receive half a day of training when they take on the role and a shorter refresher every year. The company aims to have enough wardens for at least one to be present on every floor throughout working hours, so staff who work part-time or on shifts are particularly encouraged to volunteer.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: When the alarm sounds as a continuous ringing, all staff must leave at once by the nearest exit and go to the assembly point in the car park opposite the main entrance. Do not stop to collect personal belongings, and do not use the lifts. If you are with visitors, you are responsible for taking them with you. An intermittent alarm, which sounds as a series of short rings, is a warning only: stay where you are, end any telephone calls and wait for an announcement.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Wardens have three tasks during an evacuation. They check the toilets, kitchens and meeting rooms on their floor, closing doors as they go; they help anyone who needs assistance to reach an exit or a refuge area on the stairs; and they report to the chief warden at the assembly point, confirming that their floor is clear. Wardens should not try to put out a fire unless it is very small and they have been trained to use the extinguisher, and they must never put themselves at risk.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Staff who might need help to leave the building, for example because of an injury or a condition that affects their movement, should ask their manager for a personal evacuation plan. The plan is agreed with the facilities team and reviewed whenever the person’s needs change. The whole building is evacuated for practice twice a year, at times that are not announced in advance, and the time taken to clear it is recorded and shared with all staff.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: The staff suggestion scheme. Anyone who works for the company, including temporary staff and those on fixed-term contracts, may put forward an idea for saving money, improving safety or making the working day easier. Suggestions are made through a form on the staff website; paper forms can be left in the box in the canteen by people who do not use a computer at work. Ideas may be submitted by an individual or by a team of up to four people.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Each suggestion is acknowledged within five working days and then passed to the manager of the department it would affect most. That manager has one month to assess it and to recommend whether it should be adopted, tried out on a small scale or rejected. A panel of five staff, chosen from different departments and changed every year, meets every two months to make the final decisions and to agree any awards.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Awards depend on the value of the idea. A suggestion that is adopted but brings no measurable saving receives a voucher worth £50. Where a saving can be measured, the person or team receives ten per cent of the first year’s saving, up to a limit of £5,000. Suggestions about safety are not given cash awards, because the company does not want safety matters to be delayed while savings are calculated; instead, the best safety idea each year receives a special certificate and an extra day of paid leave.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Some ideas cannot be considered. These include complaints about individual colleagues, which should be raised with a manager, and suggestions that simply repeat existing policy. An idea that has already been put forward by someone else within the previous two years will not receive an award, even if it is adopted, although the second person will be told that the idea was a good one. Anyone who is unhappy with the way their suggestion was handled may ask for it to be reviewed by the head of human resources.
paragraphs.label: D

document.title: Section 2 · fire evacuation and staff suggestions

topic.en: Two workplace texts: fire evacuation and the duties of wardens, and the staff suggestion scheme with its awards.
topic.kk: Екі жұмыс мәтіні: өрт кезіндегі эвакуация және кезекшілердің міндеті, қызметкерлер ұсынысы және оған берілетін марапат.
topic.ru: Два рабочих текста: эвакуация при пожаре и обязанности дежурных, схема предложений сотрудников и награды за них.

items.quote: Wardens are volunteers who receive half a day of training when they take on the role
items.prompt: Warden training takes place during working hours.

explanation.en: We learn how long the training is and that it is repeated yearly, not whether it happens in working hours → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Оқудың ұзақтығы және жыл сайын қайталанатыны айтылған; жұмыс уақытында өте ме — айтылмаған → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: Сказано, сколько длится обучение и что его повторяют каждый год; проходит ли оно в рабочее время — нет → NOT GIVEN.

items.quote: go to the assembly point in the car park opposite the main entrance
items.prompt: After leaving, staff should wait directly in front of the main entrance.

explanation.en: “the assembly point in the car park opposite the main entrance” → FALSE: people gather across the road, not at the entrance itself.
explanation.kk: «the assembly point in the car park opposite the main entrance» → FALSE: жиналу орны кіреберістің алдында емес, қарсы беттегі тұрақта.
explanation.ru: «the assembly point in the car park opposite the main entrance» → FALSE: место сбора на парковке напротив входа, а не у самого входа.

items.quote: An intermittent alarm, which sounds as a series of short rings, is a warning only
items.prompt: When the alarm rings on and off, people do not need to leave yet.

explanation.en: “An intermittent alarm… is a warning only: stay where you are” → TRUE: a broken ringing is just a warning.
explanation.kk: «An intermittent alarm… is a warning only: stay where you are» → TRUE: үзік-үзік дабыл — ескерту ғана.
explanation.ru: «An intermittent alarm… is a warning only: stay where you are» → TRUE: прерывистый сигнал — только предупреждение.

items.quote: Wardens should not try to put out a fire unless it is very small and they have been trained to use the extinguisher
items.prompt: Wardens are expected to put out any fire they find on their floor.

explanation.en: “should not try to put out a fire unless it is very small” → FALSE: only very small fires, and only after training.
explanation.kk: «should not try to put out a fire unless it is very small» → FALSE: тек өте кішкентай өртті және тек оқудан өткен соң сөндіруге болады.
explanation.ru: «should not try to put out a fire unless it is very small» → FALSE: тушить можно только очень маленький огонь и только после обучения.

items.quote: the time taken to clear it is recorded and shared with all staff
items.prompt: Practice evacuations have become faster over the past year.

explanation.en: The time is recorded and shared; whether it has improved is not stated → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Эвакуация уақыты жазылып, қызметкерлерге хабарланады; жылдамдағаны айтылмаған → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: Время эвакуации записывают и сообщают сотрудникам; стало ли оно лучше — не сказано → NOT GIVEN.

groups.instruction: Do the following statements agree with the information given in Text A? Write TRUE if the statement agrees with the information, FALSE if the statement contradicts the information, NOT GIVEN if there is no information on this.

items.quote: whose names and photographs are displayed beside the lifts
items.prompt: Where can staff find out who the wardens on their floor are?

explanation.en: “whose names and photographs are displayed beside the lifts” → beside the lifts.
explanation.kk: «whose names and photographs are displayed beside the lifts» → beside the lifts: кезекшілердің аты мен суреті сол жерде.
explanation.ru: «whose names and photographs are displayed beside the lifts» → beside the lifts.

items.quote: they help anyone who needs assistance to reach an exit or a refuge area on the stairs
items.prompt: Where on the stairs can wardens take people who need help?

explanation.en: “to reach an exit or a refuge area on the stairs” → a refuge area. The exit is not on the stairs.
explanation.kk: «to reach an exit or a refuge area on the stairs» → a refuge area. Шығу есігі (exit) баспалдақта емес.
explanation.ru: «to reach an exit or a refuge area on the stairs» → a refuge area. Выход (exit) — не на лестнице.

items.quote: they report to the chief warden at the assembly point, confirming that their floor is clear
items.prompt: Who do wardens tell that their floor is empty?

explanation.en: “report to the chief warden… confirming that their floor is clear” → the chief warden. “Empty” = “clear”.
explanation.kk: «report to the chief warden… confirming that their floor is clear» → the chief warden. «Empty» мен «clear» — бір мағына.
explanation.ru: «report to the chief warden… confirming that their floor is clear» → the chief warden. «Empty» = «clear».

groups.instruction: Answer the questions below about Text A. Choose NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the text for each answer.

items.quote: A panel of five staff, chosen from different departments and changed every year, meets every two months to make the final decisions
items.prompt: Who makes the final decision about a suggestion?

options.text: The manager of the department most affected
A panel of staff from different departments

explanation.en: “A panel of five staff… meets every two months to make the final decisions” → B. The department manager only recommends.
explanation.kk: «A panel of five staff… meets every two months to make the final decisions» → B. Бөлім басшысы тек ұсыныс береді.
explanation.ru: «A panel of five staff… meets every two months to make the final decisions» → B. Руководитель отдела только даёт рекомендацию.

items.quote: the best safety idea each year receives a special certificate and an extra day of paid leave
items.prompt: What can happen when a good safety idea is adopted?

options.text: Its author receives ten per cent of the saving.
It waits until the saving has been calculated.
It may win a yearly prize that is not money.
It is rewarded with a £50 voucher.

explanation.en: “the best safety idea each year receives a special certificate and an extra day of paid leave” → C. Safety ideas get no cash.
explanation.kk: «the best safety idea each year receives a special certificate and an extra day of paid leave» → C. Қауіпсіздік туралы ұсынысқа ақша берілмейді.
explanation.ru: «the best safety idea each year receives a special certificate and an extra day of paid leave» → C. Денег за идеи о безопасности не дают.

groups.instruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B, C or D. The questions are about Text B.

items.quote: Ideas may be submitted by an individual or by a team of up to four people.
items.prompt: Largest team that can submit an idea: 11 ____ people

explanation.en: “by a team of up to four people” → four. Five is the size of the panel, not of a team.
explanation.kk: «by a team of up to four people» → four. Бес адам — топ емес, комиссия құрамы.
explanation.ru: «by a team of up to four people» → four. Пять человек — это состав комиссии, не команды.

items.quote: That manager has one month to assess it

explanation.en: “That manager has one month to assess it” → month. “Five working days” is the time to acknowledge a suggestion.
explanation.kk: «That manager has one month to assess it» → month. «Five working days» — ұсыныстың алынғанын растау мерзімі.
explanation.ru: «That manager has one month to assess it» → month. «Five working days» — срок, за который подтверждают получение.

items.prompt: Upper limit of a cash award: 13 ____

explanation.en: “up to a limit of £5,000” → £5,000. £50 is the voucher for ideas with no measurable saving.
explanation.kk: «up to a limit of £5,000» → £5,000. £50 — үнемдеуі өлшенбейтін ұсынысқа берілетін ваучер.
explanation.ru: «up to a limit of £5,000» → £5,000. £50 — ваучер для идей без измеримой экономии.
